themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents performing research tasks autonomously, including agents that can interact with systems, gather information, and execute workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Explores various AI-powered tools used to aid in research processes, from data analysis to discovery and synthesis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries and extract key insights.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Focuses on comparing, reviewing, and assessing the performance and utility of different AI tools and platforms.

themes.name: AI for design research
themes.description: Examines how AI is being integrated into the design process for research purposes, including concept generation and user experience design.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use of AI chatbots in research, including their capabilities, limitations, and impact on user interaction and information gathering.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated personas or 'synthetic users' for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI for qualitative research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI techniques to qualitative research methods, such as analyzing text or identifying themes in user feedback.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating testing processes for software and products, including regression testing and quality assurance.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
